summary: The Tenant has an obligation to pay a monthly rent of 18,000, which must be paid on or before the 5th day of each calendar month. The Tenant must also use the Premises primarily for residential purposes and comply with apartment association rules. The Tenant can terminate the agreement after six months with two months' notice. The Landlord must return the balance security deposit within 30 days after termination.
